text: Select: metabolism.met_id, metabolism.met_conversion, metabolism.pathway_key, metabolism.enzyme_name, substrate.compound_name AS substrate_name, parent.compound_name AS parent_name, substrate_struct.canonical_smiles. Source: metabolism. Join: Join compound_records substrate ON metabolism.substrate_record_id = substrate.record_id. Join compound_structures substrate_struct ON substrate.molregno = substrate_struct.molregno. Left Join compound_records parent ON metabolism.drug_record_id = parent.record_id. Filter: metabolism.tax_id = 9483 (Callithrix jacchus). Sort: metabolism.met_id ascending. Limit: 200.
